articles.title: Rs 454-crore corridor along Najafgarh drain could assuage Delhi’s traffic woes
articles.description: The Capital’s long struggle with traffic congestion could see a new intervention, with the government deciding to move ahead with its plan to develop a nearly 61-kilometre green corridor along the Najafgarh Drain.
